simple.meaning: שָׁכַךְ (shâkak) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to weave (i.e. lay) a trap ; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Genesis, Numbers, Esther, Jeremiah, beginning at Genesis 8:1. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁכַךְ (H7918).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁכַךְ (shâkak) / H7918 is traced through Genesis 8:1, Numbers 17:20, Esther 2:1, Esther 7:10 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: to weave (i.e. lay) a trap ; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood)

firstOccurrence.englishText: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

timeline.evidenceText: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.
After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.
So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.
For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

definitions.full: H7918. shakak [ שָׁכַךְ ] verb decrease, abate (Late Hebrew שְׁכִיכָה is allaying of anger; אֹזֶן שִׁכֵּךְ soothe, satisfy the ear (so apparently Dalm), i.e. allow it to hear and understand, compare Levy NHWB (and Arabic be narrow have small ears, be deaf , Frä 90 ); — Arabic see humble oneself , Wahrm humiliate ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיָּשֹׁכוּ Gen 8:1 the waters abated ; Infinitive construct כְּשֹׁךְ Est 2:1 when abated the king's wrath, so Perfect 3feminine singular שָׁכָ֑כָה 7:10 . — יְקוּשִׁים כְּשַׁךְ Jer 5:26 usually like the bending, crouching, of fowlers (this meaning for שַׁךְ dubious; Dr כְּשֻׁר Du strike out כשׁ ישׁור , then reads א בַּשַּׁחַת הִצִּיבוּ ׳מוֺקְשִׁים יִלְכֹּדוּ׃ ). Hiph`il Perfect 1singular consecutive מֵעָלַי וַהֲשִׁכֹּתִ֫י Numbers 17:20 I will allay from upon me the murmurings (accusative), etc.
